text: 【10月13日午间新闻精选】1、截至午间收盘，上证指数跌0.27%，深证成指跌0.78%，创业板指跌0.95%。2、港股午间收盘，恒生指数跌0.39%，恒生科技指数跌1.54%。3、多家硅料企业联合召开闭门会，约定平均成本含税价不低于每吨4.3万元。4、IMF预测2026年全球实际GDP增长率为3.1%（7月预测值为3.0%），主要原因为关键经济体的AI投资缓和了能源价格冲击的影响。IMF预测2027年全球经济增长率为3.4%，与7月预测持平（2025年实际增长率为3.5%）。5、韩国KOSPI指数跌幅扩大至7%，SK海力士跌超9%，三星电子跌逾8%。
text_en: [October 13 Midday News Highlights] 1. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.27%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.78%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.95%. 2. At the Hong Kong midday close, the Hang Seng Index fell 0.39%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.54%. 3. Several polysilicon companies jointly held a closed-door meeting and agreed that the average cost, including tax, should be no less than 43,000 yuan per ton. 4. The IMF forecasts global real GDP growth of 3.1% in 2026 (July forecast: 3.0%), mainly because AI investment in key economies eased the impact of energy price shocks. The IMF forecasts global economic growth of 3.4% in 2027, unchanged from its July forecast (actual growth in 2025 was 3.5%). 5. South Korea's KOSPI index extended its decline to 7%, SK Hynix fell more than 9%, and Samsung Electronics fell more than 8%.
